reviewed.head: bf28e2f93bf94f71dda995505813cdc0d0537fb7
reviewed.review_of: design-only bootstrap witness linux profile and commit fencing

findings.issue: No selected/provisioned independent issuer, trust anchor, OS principal/custodian or revocation authority; source receipt is not an authority.
required_evidence: OS principal/root ancestor identity under restart
signed receipt and revocation negative tests

findings.issue: Candidate compare-and-advance service lacks selected separate operator, linearizable state store, key governance and verifiable disaster-recovery proof.
required_evidence: atomic per-run CAS and equivocation tests

findings.issue: No concrete single serialization point couples current fencing epoch/holder and expected-head publication; check-then-rename and OFD locks alone are insufficient.
required_evidence: choose and review atomic authority protocol
epoch-7 to epoch-8 stale-writer counterexample rejected

findings.issue: Candidate ext4 lacks exact kernel/build/mount/block-device/cache profile and measured file/directory/head durability.
required_evidence: fixed allowlist and unsupported error mapping
file+directory fsync, no-replace, crash/power-loss test results

findings.issue: No independent human/organizational sign-off, dependency grant or separately authorized fixture-only prototype release.
Existing Python readiness checker is a design-only linter; its exit code 0 means DESIGN_ONLY_BLOCKED, not operational readiness.
required_evidence: distinct signed future approval artifact and verifier
no CI step treats linter success as permission
